topics.question: What does the Public Gathering Bill propose, and has its status changed?
topics.sourceTitle: Public Gathering Bill, N.A.B. No. 71 of 2026
topics.context: Explore the published bill alongside Parliament's committee report. A bill is a proposal, not proof of the law currently in force.
topics.status: Passage, assent and commencement have not been verified. Check the current status before relying on any proposal.

topics.question: When can a business share my personal data without asking me?
topics.context: Start with the published Data Protection Act and investigate the lawful basis for sharing personal data.
topics.status: Check applicable exceptions and current amendments. Do not assume consent is the only lawful basis or that sharing automatically establishes a breach.
